scope: Checked CPU int32 reduceSum through ranked tensor views and CPU task continuations.

semantics.types: CPU int32 tensor input and exact int32 scalar result, including rank zero. No implicit conversions. Integer matmul and Metal int32 remain diagnosed.
semantics.order: Row-major balanced-adjacent tree; sum neighboring pairs and carry an odd final element unchanged. Each sum sign-extends to int64, checks int32 bounds and narrows. Empty input is integer zero.
semantics.overflow: Intermediate tree overflow faults even when the final mathematical total fits, for example [2147483647,1,-1]. The source reduceSum location is preserved. This is not widened-total or sequential-fold accumulation.
semantics.reuse: Shared existing reduction scratch/tree lowering is element-aware. Float32 still uses the previous f32 tree/additions. Runtime, checked invocation ABI, continuation planner and task backend unchanged.
semantics.ownership: Scratch storage belongs to the invocation; input remains immutable. Successful, overflowed, allocation-failed and cancelled invocations settle all allocations.
semantics.task_integration: Exact scalar results, nested worker tasks and cached awaits reuse existing task layouts. Child overflow is TaskError.Fault/Arithmetic; handlers reuse parent tensor data and start another group.

coverage: signed endpoints and exact values above float32 precision
every empty axis and odd tails
intermediate overflow despite in-range mathematical total
borrowed aligned/offset views with padded strides
negative dimensions and byte-count overflow rejected before loads
scratch allocation failure and settled owners
rank-zero pre-cancellation and ranked runtime cancellation triggered after polling begins
sibling tensor handoff and exact int32 scalar results
scoped Arithmetic recovery and another parallel group
uncaught synchronous/task overflow with original source location and task cleanup

initial_full_run.assertion: controller assumed the finite kernel remained running after observing its poll count

regression_test_repair.diagnosis: The controller can be descheduled while the finite kernel completes. The original test passed five isolated repeats. No sanitizer memory error was reported.
regression_test_repair.change: Bounded retries settle completed attempts and still require an actually interrupted kernel, correct cancellation/deadline classification and full cleanup for each shape. Runtime/compiler cancellation behavior unchanged.
regression_test_repair.focused_recheck: All four compiled-worker variants passed after the test repair.

distributed_execution: Not implemented; separate design-review gate retained.
